facts.text: John mentioned that they had to say goodbye to Max, who was an important part of their family for 10 years.

evidence.quote: The toughest thing to deal with is that we had to say goodbye to Max. He was such an important part of our family for 10 years and it's so hard to think he's not here wagging that tail anymore.

facts.text: John expressed that they are still sad about Max's passing but are comforted by the good times and memories they had with him.

evidence.quote: We're all still sad about it, but have been comforted by the good times we had and the memories we have. It's tough, but we'll keep doing our best.

facts.text: John shared a picture of Max sitting in the grass with a leash, which he described as a cherished memory.

evidence.quote: Here's a picture of him that I cherish.
Max looks so peaceful in that photo, just chilling in the backyard.
